title: APEX BH Group
description: A visual identity and campaign system for APEX BH Group, an automotive service business. The supplied work combines a red-and-green wordmark, logo variants, typography and product-led service campaigns.
challenge: Keep an automotive service brand recognizable across identity sheets, maintenance messages and oil-product promotions.
solution: The identity uses an italic wordmark and a red, green, black and white palette. Campaign layouts connect workshop imagery, vehicles and product photography under the APEX mark.
results: Selected logo guidelines and campaign designs from the supplied source files. No campaign performance or launch results are claimed.
category: Brand identity • Brand guidelines • Social media design
